BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of tlie Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-1 in the area bounded by:

               A line 250.0 feet south of and parallel to West LeMoyne Street; the public alley
               next east of and parallel to North Fairfield Avenue; and a line 275.0 feet south of
               and parallel to West LeMoyne Street; and North Fairfield Avenue

to those of an RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

publication.

                                             From RS-3 to RM-4.5
The Proiect
Robert Bihlman II (the "Applicant") proposes to rezone the subject property, which is improved with a four stoiy
residential building with three dwelling units and a two car garage to allow the addition of one additional dwelling
unit in the basement to convert the building from three to four dwelling units. No additional parking is proposed.
The existing height of the building is approximately 42.0' to the top of the parapet. The proposed height of flie
building will remain.

To allow the proposed project, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning classification for the subject property ftom
a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District to a RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit District The
Applicant is electing to file this rezoning as a Type 1 rezoning amendment application.

The Site
The subject property is located on the east side of North Fairfield Avenue between West LeMoyne Street and
West Hirsh Street. The overall area is residential in nature and includes multi residential buildings. The subject
site contains 3,125 square feet of land and is improved with a four stoiy residential building with three residential
dwelling units and a two car garage. The existing building height is approximately 42.0' to the top of the parapet
The Applicant proposes to rezone the property to add one additional dwelling unit in the basement to convert lhe
buildingfromthree to four dwellingunits. No additional paiking is proposed. The existing height ofthe building
wiil remain.
